svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.21 MASONRY AND CONCRETE CHIMNEYS AND FLUES

g.text: Open joints: smoke and flame escape

svg.text: The walls of any chimney or flue pipe are
constructed so as to be smoke- and
Drawn: chimney cut through the flue, liner tinted clay, open joints exaggerated. Sizes are illustration only.
